name: משוואה לינארית עם סוגריים – סכום שני ביטויים שווה 0 (באנגלית)
generalfeedback:
The objective is to get the equation into the form \({{CT:2}} = p\) where \(p\) is a rational number. To obtain \({{CT:2}}\) on one side of the equation it may be necessary to under-take several operations which must be performed on both sides of the equation. In this example:
\[ {{CT:1}} = 0.\] We are first required to expand the brackets and collect like terms: \[ {{CT:3}} = 0. \] Then move the constants to one side keeping the variables on the other: \[ {{CT:4}} = {{CT:5}}.\] Then divide by the coefficient of \({{CT:2}}\) (\({{CT:6}}\)): \[ {{CT:2}} = {{CT:7}}. \] And so we now have obtained a value for {{CT:0}}.
